title: Teaser for "The Real T. Rex"
content: Here's a teaser for “The Real T. Rex” coming up in the April issue ofRanger Rick Magazine. (Link to video on Facebook)----Questions:Karin Spijkerasks:Is that varnish over a handmade gouache painting?James GurneyI'm varnishing an oil painting, though I did some gouache studies before starting the oil.Edison Coronado Vallejoasks:Will there be a making-of video of this painting??? PleaseJames GurneyYes, I've got extensive coverage of behind-the-scenes, and will release a free YouTube version and a longer Gumroad tutorial about unconventional painting techniques.
